SiteSetting.title: SiteSetting

servicesPageSubtitle.description: The subtitle paragraph for the services page.

servicesElectronicsTitle.description: Title for the electronics scrap section on the services page.

servicesElectronicsText.description: Main text for the electronics scrap section on the services page.

servicesElectronicsSubtitle.description: Subtitle for the old appliances part of the electronics section.

servicesElectronicsImageId.description: Image ID for the electronics scrap section on the services page.

CompanyInfo.title: CompanyInfo
CompanyInfo.description: Information about the company and its owner, primarily for the 'About Us' page and editable via the admin panel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CompanyInfo entity. (PK)

ownerFullName.description: The full name of the business owner.

ownerImageId.description: Reference to the Image entity for the business owner's photo. (Relationship: CompanyInfo 1:1 Image)

contactPhoneNumber.description: The primary contact phone number for the company or owner, separate from the site-wide WhatsApp number.

companyAddress.description: The full physical address of the company's business location. Updates here should reflect on the 'About Us' page map.

mapEmbedUrl.description: The embeddable URL for a map (e.g., Google Maps) showing the company's location on the 'About Us' page. This can be updated by the admin.

aboutUsContent.description: The main content or narrative text for the 'About Us' page.

instagramUrl.description: The full URL for the company's Instagram profile.

facebookUrl.description: The full URL for the company's Facebook profile.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Details about a specific service offered by the company, including descriptions and associated imagery.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Service entity. (PK)

title.description: The title or name of the service.

description.description: A detailed description of what the service entails.

imageIds.description: An array of references to Image entities associated with this service, allowing multiple photos per service. (Relationship: Service 1:N Image)

displayOrder.description: A numerical value indicating the order in which this service should be displayed on the services page.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A product available for sale, such as a used refrigerator or other scrap items.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity. (PK)

description.description: A brief description of the product.

price.description: Price of the product in TL.

stock.description: How many units are in stock.

imageId.description: Reference to the Image entity for the product's photo.

createdAt.description: The date the product was listed.

Blog.title: Blog
Blog.description: A blog post containing content related to scrap and recycling, optimized for SEO and editable through the admin panel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Blog entity. (PK)

title.description: The title of the blog post.

slug.description: A URL-friendly version of the title, used for clean URLs.

content.description: The full rich-text content of the blog post, possibly in HTML or Markdown format.

publishDate.description: The date and time when the blog post was published.

author.description: The author of the blog post (e.g., 'Atık Rehber Ekibi').

metaDescription.description: A concise summary of the blog post content, used for SEO meta tags.

keywords.description: An array of keywords relevant to the blog post, used for SEO and content discovery. Can be researched and generated by an AI assistant.

thumbnailImageId.description: Reference to the Image entity used as the thumbnail for this blog post. (Relationship: Blog 1:1 Image)

isFeaturedOnHomepage.description: A flag indicating if this blog post should be featured on the website's homepage (up to 3 posts).

Image.title: Image
Image.description: A centralized entity for managing all images uploaded to the website, facilitating reuse and administration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Image entity. (PK)

url.description: The public URL where the image file is hosted.

altText.description: Alternative text for the image, important for accessibility and SEO.

caption.description: An optional caption or short description for the image, displayed below it.

uploadDate.description: The date and time when the image was uploaded.

usageContext.description: A category or description indicating where and how this image is typically used (e.g., 'Logo', 'Blog Thumbnail', 'Service Gallery', 'About Us Photo').

definition.description: Dedicated collection for defining administrators. The document ID is the user's unique Firebase Authentication UID. The mere existence of a document at this path signifies that the corresponding user is an administrator. This collection is crucial for Authorization Independence.

params.name: adminUid
params.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of a user designated as an administrator.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to be highly secure, scalable, and debuggable by strictly adhering to the core design principles. All publicly accessible content (Site Settings, Company Information, Services, Products, Blog Posts, and Images) resides in top-level collections. This ensures that read operations for regular users are straightforward and do not require any authorization checks, directly supporting Query-Based Authorization Patterns (QAPs) as rules are not used as filters.

Authorization for administration is managed via a dedicated 'roles_admin' collection. An administrator's UID will exist as a document ID within this collection (e.g., /roles_admin/{adminUid}). This approach ensures **Authorization Independence** because write access to any managed content collection (e.g., /siteSettings, /blogs, /images) is granted by a simple, atomic `get()` call to check for the existence of `request.auth.uid` in the `/roles_admin` collection. This explicit role-based access avoids complex hierarchical dependencies or reliance on parent document attributes, which can break atomic operations and make rules difficult to debug. This design centralizes admin role management and makes the authorization intent for all write operations clear and easy to audit.

All documents within a given collection share a homogeneous security posture (publicly readable, admin-writeable), simplifying security rules significantly and preventing QAP violations. The structure also employs clear and descriptive path parameters and entity names for enhanced debuggability and maintainability.
